description: This file defines the TypeNameGrainPropertiesProvider class, which populates metadata properties related to grain types and grain interface types within the Orleans framework. It implements interfaces for providing properties for grains and grain interfaces, specifically setting type name, full name, and diagnostic info.

classes.name: TypeNameGrainPropertiesProvider
classes.description: A class that populates metadata properties for grain classes and interfaces, such as type name, full name, and assembly diagnostics, used within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: Populate (Type grainClass, GrainType grainType, Dictionary<string, string> properties)
methods.description: Populates properties dictionary with type name, full type name, and diagnostic info for a grain class.

methods.name: Populate (Type interfaceType, GrainInterfaceType interfaceId, Dictionary<string, string> properties)
methods.description: Populates properties dictionary with interface type name and diagnostic info for a grain interface.
